nodes.name: NiFe LDH chemical stability test
nodes.procedure: NiFe LDH was immersed for 60 h in 1.0 M KOH at 25°C and separately in 7.5 M KOH at 80°C, resulting in structural transformation including replacement of NO₃⁻ anions with CO₃²⁻ or OH⁻ ions (1M case) and complete transformation to β-Ni(OH)₂, amorphous FeOOH, and minor α-FeOOH (7.5M case).

nodes.description: OER on Ni(OH)₂ nanoparticles (20-500 nm) on carbon nanoelectrodes

trend.value: decreases with increase in particle size

nodes.source_text: study of the OER on different nanosized Ni(OH)₂ particles in the size range from 20 to 500nm electrodeposited on carbon nanoelectrodes, the TOF was observed to decrease with increase in Ni(OH)₂ particle size. The obtained TOFs were 1-3 orders of magnitude higher than reported for experiments performed on macroelectrodes.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD analysis of NiFe LDH shows decrease in basal spacing after 60h immersion in 1.0M KOH (shift of (003) reflection to 2θ=11.2°) and complete transformation to β-Ni(OH)₂ + amorphous FeOOH + minor α-FeOOH after 7.5M KOH treatment.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD analysis disclosed a decrease in the basal spacing of the NiFe-LDH structure after treatment in 1.0M KOH (80° for 60h) indicated by a shift of the (003) reflection to a higher value (20 = 11.2°)... The sample treated in 7.5M KOH (80° for 60h) underwent complete chemical and structural transformation into a mixture of crystalline β-Ni(OH)₂ as detected by XRD...

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM and SAED reveal amorphous FeOOH and minor crystalline domains of α-FeOOH in NiFe LDH after 7.5M KOH treatment.
nodes.evidence_snippet: ...and amorphous FeOOH and minor crystalline domains of α-FeOOH that were revealed by HRTEM and SAED.

nodes.characterization_summary: LSV shows OER overpotential increase from 340 mV (pristine) to 370 mV (1M KOH treated) and 420 mV (7.5M KOH treated) at 10 mA cm⁻²; Tafel slope increases from 52 mV/dec to 118 mV/dec and 148 mV/dec respectively.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The overpotential required to attain a current density of 10mA cm⁻² increased from 340mV for pristine NiFe-LDH to 370mV and 420mV for the NiFe-LDH samples treated in 1.0M KOH and 7.5M KOH, respectively. Furthermore, the Tafel slope of the OER changed markedly, increasing from 52mV/dec for the pristine sample to 118mV/dec and 148mV/dec...
